newsitem.title: UK: Moody's assigns Alfa Bank ratings.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns Alfa Bank ratings.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Mondsay it had assigned to Alfa Bank ratings of B1 for long-term deposits, Not Prime for short-term deposits, and D for bank financial strength.
Moody's also assigned to Alfa-Russia Finance B.V. a rating of B1/ Not Prime for its Euro medium- term- note programme, guaranteed by Alfa Bank, it said in a statement.
"The ratings of Alfa Bank reflect the bank's significant market position in Russia, its currently low level of customer credit risk, and its relatively good risk-based capitalisation," Moody's said.
"The ratings also incorporate, however, loan and deposit lending concentrations, rapid expected loan growth, and the difficult environment in which the bank operates."
